data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that can be dragged around the screen.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget that can be moved by the user via drag gestures. It offers customizable initial position, margins, shadows and a controller to programmatically show, hide or move it.
use_when: You need a floating button that the user can reposition
You want a draggable UI element without writing custom gesture code
You need a simple, customizable drag‑and‑drop widget that works on mobile and web
avoid_when: You require physics‑based motion or snapping beyond basic anchoring
You need a full drag‑and‑drop framework with data transfer
strengths: Supports all Flutter platforms including web
Provides a controller for programmatic control
weaknesses: Limited to a single widget; not a full drag‑and‑drop system
No built‑in physics or snapping beyond four anchor points
data.minimal_example:
Stack(
  children:[
    DraggableWidget(
      bottomMargin:80,
      topMargin:80,
      intialVisibility:true,
      horizontalSpace:20,
      shadowBorderRadius:50,
      child:Container(height:100,width:100,decoration:BoxDecoration(shape:BoxShape.circle,color:Colors.blue)),
      initialPosition:AnchoringPosition.bottomLeft,
      dragController:dragController,
    ),
  ],
)
